Name: East Scarp Inn Spirit's Eve Festival Outfits PATCH
Author: bananasalmon
Description:
[center][b][size=6][u]20260525: this mod is obsolete since Seasonal Outfits 6.1.1!!! download if you play with older versions!!![/u][/size][/b][/center]

[size=3][b]Introduction[/b][/size]
Patch created because of a map name change from East Scarp version 3.0 or higher for the East Scarp Inn during Fall 27.

[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Thanks to CMCT, you can safely install this mod even if you are combining Seasonal Outfits with other outfit mods.

Also compatible with older versions of East Scarp: the old map name is not removed from the code, only the new map name added.

[size=3][b]Roadmap[/b][/size]
[u]20260525: this mod is obsolete since Seasonal Outfits 6.1.1!!![/u] Thanks to  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/255078394]AverageFazeFan[/url] for implementing the fix in the mod itself. Also thanks to all of you for the downloads and endorsements.

This mod will stay available in two versions: one for Seasonal Outfits 6.1.0, and one for Seasonal Outfits 6.0.1 or lower.

Note: I know Shane gives yellow lines in SMAPI, but trust me he works. I am not going to change his code.
